title: Schema check skips error statuses that carry no JSON body
notes: checker.go returns nil for a non-2xx answer whose content type is not JSON, before counting it. A 4xx or 5xx text body where the schema declares a JSON type for that status is not reported, although the spec says 'no JSON body where the schema gives one'. Closed at the pivot: Tied to a Jellyfin route, a Jellyfin app, jellyfin-web, Quick Connect or Jellyfin's tooling, all removed at the cutover (D-107, D-109, rule 3).
